Read the Geographic Attributes File

Source: R/geo_suite.R
get_statcan_geographic_attributes.Rd

Reads the geographic attributes for the given census year, with one row for each area of the lowest census geography. The table contains the information on how all the geographic levels are related for each area, along with population and dwelling counts and representative points.

The data comes from parquet files hosted at https://data.mountainmath.ca/census/geo_attributes/, as Statistics Canada now blocks programmatic downloads of these files. The files are derived from Statistics Canada data under the Statistics Canada Open Licence. They get downloaded on first use and cached if the cancensus cache path has been set, and cached copies only get updated with refresh = TRUE. Reading the files requires the duckdb and DBI packages.

A reference guide for the 2021 file is available at https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/en/catalogue/92-151-G2021001

Usage

get_statcan_geographic_attributes(
  census_year = "2021",
  refresh = FALSE,
  language = getOption("cancensus.language", "en"),
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

census_year

census year to get the data for, one of 1981, 1986, 1991, 1996, 2001, 2006, 2011, 2016 or 2021

refresh

(logical) download the file again if true, and report if it has changed

language

language of the column labels, one of "en" or "fr". Defaults to the cancensus.language option, and to "en" if that is not set. This does not change the data.

quiet

(logical) suppress messages and the progress bar if TRUE. Warnings about failed downloads are still shown.

Value

tibble with the attribute data, with a description of each column in its "label" attribute. The "metadata" attribute of the tibble holds the metadata of the file, including the attribution, licence, source and notes. If the file can't be downloaded this gives a warning, and returns the cached data when refreshing existing cached data and NULL otherwise.

Differences between census years

Column names follow the 2021 file, but the available columns differ between census years. The main change is between 1996 and 2001:

  • 2001 to 2021 have one row per dissemination block, identified by DBUID. There is no 2001 attribute file, the 2001 data was derived from the 2001 GeoSuite and has no total dwelling counts or block areas.

  • 1981 to 1996 have one row per enumeration area, identified by EAUID. These have different columns, for example CTCODE instead of CTUID and no dissemination areas.

Identifiers are only unique within a census year, the same DBUID or EAUID in another year does not generally refer to the same area. In 2001 and 2006 the fields for census metropolitan areas and agglomerations, census tracts and urban areas were filled outside of those areas to match the files from 2011 on, so not all of these values are in the source. The notes_en entry of the metadata has details on this and on any problems with the source of each file.

Examples

# read the attributes for the 2021 census
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
attributes <- get_statcan_geographic_attributes("2021")
# where the data comes from
attr(attributes, "metadata")$attribution_en
} # }
